catalog.hardwareUnknown: Zambiri za Hardware zikusowa; zomwe mungakonde zimafunika RAM ndi GPU data.
catalog.contextTip: Nkhani zazifupi zimagwiritsa ntchito kukumbukira pang'ono osasintha kukula kwake.
catalog.nvfp4Search: Blackwell GPU yokhala ndi zokumbukira zokwanira imapezedwa. Kukonda NVFP4 zosiyanitsidwa ndi zomangamanga ndi injini zimathandizira. Wachibadwidwe FLUX.2 Klein 4B Kutsegula kosangalatsa kumapezeka komwe kuli komweko; fufuzani CUDA PyTorch, zodalira zomwe mungafune, zitsanzo zina ndi zokumbukira zaulere musanatsitse. Kuzindikira kwa Hardware sikutsimikizira nthawi yokonzekera kapena kuthamanga kwa chitsimikizo.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 angapangire GPU ndi FLUX.2 Klein 4B banja. Kutsegula kwachikale kumafuna masanjidwe a Comfy, CUDA PyTorch ndi zodalira zomwe mungasankhe. Sankhani mtundu wa chithunzi, Qwen3 encoder ndi VAE padera pa zochunira za Creation. Nthawi yothamanga, kuphatikiza kwathunthu ndi kukumbukira kwaulere kumafunikirabe kutsimikiziridwa.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 chazindikirika: kuthekera kwa GPU, kukumbukira kwaulere, masanjidwe a kulemera kapena thandizo la kamangidwe sizotsimikizika. Yang'anani injini ya CUDA musanasankhe izi. Maonekedwe okhawo sakhazikitsa kugwirizana.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: Chilengedwe NVFP4 sichivomerezedwa ndi GPU kapena yaulere VRAM yapano. Ganizirani za GGUF quantization kapena injini yofananira. Njirayi siyipereka mathamangitsidwe amtundu wa FP4.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Novera GGUF upangiri wamawu, zithunzi ndi makanema: Q6_K kapena kupitilira apo ndiye poyambira pomwe tikuyika kukhulupirika patsogolo; Q4_K_M imayang'anira bwino komanso kukumbukira. Awa ndi malingaliro, osati kulondola kwapadziko lonse. Zotsatira zimadalira chitsanzo ndi ntchito. NVFP4 ndi masikimu ena owerengera amafunikira kuwunika kwawo komanso kuwunika kwawo.
